author: Good Enough
description:
Hidden beneath a quiet forest in Florida lies one of the most dangerous cave diving sites in the United States. Eagle’s Nest Sink drops more than 300 feet into a massive underwater cave system, where deep shafts, narrow tunnels, and low visibility have trapped many experienced divers.

Often called “The Mount Everest of Cave Diving,” this cave pushes even elite divers to their limits. Warning signs at the entrance make it clear: only highly trained cave divers should attempt to enter.
